reasonCodeDescription: Mastercard Dispute Resolution — Violation of Rules

communications.subject: Welcome to ProAccess Business Tools — Annual Plan
communications.body: Your annual membership is active! Plan: Annual ($299.00/year). Your membership renews automatically each year. We will notify you before each renewal. You can cancel anytime from your account settings.

communications.timing: [7 days before the disputed charge — notification was scheduled but NOT sent]
communications.subject: SYSTEM ERROR: Pre-renewal notification email was NOT sent
communications.body: The automated pre-renewal notification email, which should have been sent 7 days before the annual renewal date, failed to send due to a misconfiguration in the email notification system after a platform update. The merchant acknowledges this failure.

communications.subject: Unauthorized renewal charge — $299.00
communications.body: I was charged $299.00 for an annual renewal but I was never notified this was coming. I would have cancelled if I had been reminded. I want a full refund.

communications.subject: RE: Unauthorized renewal charge
communications.body: We sincerely apologize for the lack of notification before your renewal. Due to a system update, the pre-renewal reminder email was not sent. However, your annual membership has been renewed and you have full access to all features. We're unable to process a refund at this time but have escalated your case to our billing department.
